MonsterTerm.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/MonsterTerm/ with isolated venv. Set MONSTER_TOKEN in .env to enable API access.

Retirement.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/Retirement/ with isolated venv. Set ROBINHOOD_USERNAME/PASSWORD in ~/.env to fetch holdings.

WarpStrand-Driver.tip: Installs to ~/TankuOS/Apps/WarpStrand-Driver/ with isolated venv and config migration.
